# multi-agent-development-workbench

> A local, provider-independent workbench for routing and supervising Claude,
> Codex, Grok, and API-backed coding agents through shared workflows.

spec-first: doc/arch is the source of truth — run `speckit status` then `speckit next` and read the spec before writing any code.

## Start Here

- [Repository guide](AGENTS.md): project structure, commands, gates, and contribution rules
- [Project status](docs/project/STATUS.md): delivered baseline, known gaps, and ordered roadmap
- [Human overview](README.md): product experience and architecture
- [Constitution](doc/arch/memory/constitution.md): non-negotiable design and governance principles
- [Product overview](doc/arch/functional/product-overview.md): actors and end-to-end flow

## Speckit Workflow

Run `speckit status`, then execute only the phase from `speckit next`.
The lifecycle is `specify` → `clarify` → `plan` → `tasks` → `analyze` →
`implement`. Use `speckit validate` before commits, `speckit verify` for
Gherkin bindings, `speckit spec score` for corpus health, and `speckit missing`
for the ranked advisory queue. Never edit `doc/.specify/` directly or bypass
the guard.
